# 🤝 Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to blit.nvim!
We welcome bug reports, feature requests, documentation improvements, and other suggestions.

## 🪧 Before You Start

- Check if there's an existing [issue](https://github.com/optiflowic/blit.nvim/issues) for your idea.
- Make sure you're running the latest version of blit.nvim.
- If you're not sure how to proceed, feel free to open a `question` issue or start a [Discussion](https://github.com/optiflowic/blit.nvim/discussions).
- Read `AGENTS.md` first — it documents the project's non-negotiable constraints (zero external dependencies, supported terminals, architecture layering) and coding standards.

## 🐞 Reporting Issues

When reporting a bug:

- Use the `Bug Report` issue template.
- Specify your terminal (kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty), Neovim version, and OS.
- Include steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behavior, and any relevant `:checkhealth blit` output.

## ✨ Suggesting Features

When suggesting a feature:

- Use the `Feature Request` issue template.
- Describe the problem it solves. Note that anything requiring an external binary, luarocks, or a Neovim version below 0.10 is out of scope per `AGENTS.md`.

## 🛠️ Making Pull Requests

- Fork the repository and create a feature branch from `main`.
- Follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`).
- Run `make` before submitting — it runs `stylua --check`, `selene`, and the test suite.
- Update the relevant `docs/spec/` memo if you touch protocol or terminal-detection behavior.
- Link to the related issue using `Closes #123`.

## 🧰 Local Development

No external tooling beyond Neovim itself, [stylua](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua), and [selene](https://github.com/Kampfkarren/selene) is required.

### Common Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `make` | `format-check` + `lint` + `test` (same as CI) |
| `make test` | Run the unit test suite (mini.test, headless Neovim) |
| `make format` | Format with stylua |
| `make format-check` | Check formatting without writing (`stylua --check .`) |
| `make lint` | Lint with selene |
